answer: Bind each epoch answer to a verifiable delay function keyed to the epoch seed and the agent's address: the agent must run a sequential computation that takes minutes of wall-clock time and cannot be parallelized, then attach the proof. A sybil farmer spinning up a tide of fresh identities gains nothing — every fake must pay the same serial time, so throughput caps at one answer per core per window instead of scaling with identity count. The old fable that more accounts means more reward breaks: the ripple of cheap clones stalls against a wall of time no one can buy in bulk.
